# wiki-lint

## Lint Report Format

Create at `wiki/meta/lint-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md`:

# Lint Report: YYYY-MM-DD

## Summary
- Pages scanned: N
- Issues found: N

## Orphan Pages
- [[Page Name]]: no inbound links.

## Dead Links
- [[Page Name]] links to [[Missing]].

## Missing Pages
- [[Missing]] is linked from two pages.

## Frontmatter Gaps
- [[Page Name]]: no `status:`.
